summary: A floating bar that appears when tasks are selected and offers complete, set urgent, or delete for all of them at once.
purpose: Lets the user act on many tasks together.
why: Likely reason: saves time when the user is working with several tasks at once.
how: Shows nothing when no tasks are selected. Otherwise shows the count, then three buttons that each send one action for all selected ids to the store and then clear the selection, plus a close button.
inputs: The list of selected task ids, and a function that clears the selection.
outputs: Changes sent to the store for all selected tasks, and an empty selection afterwards.
risks: Delete removes the selected tasks immediately with no confirmation. The store function must correctly handle each action name.
debug: If nothing happens, check the bulk update function in the store and the ids passed in. If the bar does not appear, check the length of the selection list. If tasks disappear unexpectedly, check which button was clicked.
